[[File:Space Wrinkle.jpg|250px|thumb|An X-wing fighter and a TIE Advanced fighter encountering a Space Wrinkle]]
'''Space Wrinkles''' were astronomical objects invisible to the naked eye. Ships that got near it were thrown off elsewhere in [[Realspace/Legends|Realspace]].<ref name="EBC">''[[Star Wars: Electronic Battle Command]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Space Wrinkles were introduced in [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] [[1979]] ''[[Star Wars: Electronic Battle Command]]'' game as obstacles for the player. The packaging refers to them as something that will "cast you into another galaxy." The phenomena were seen only as red LED lights on the game's screen.<ref name="Manual">{{WebCite|url=https://www.manualslib.com/manual/1428928/Kenner-Electronic-Battle-Command-Star-Wars.html|text=''Star Wars: Electronic Battle Command'' Game - Game Play manual|work=[http://gomi321.com Gomi's Nostalgia Site]|format=PDF|archivedate=20210923151947}}</ref>
